_about: Garathorm Cathedral (levels 15-25): the abandoned cathedral and its catacombs. Grave rats and belfry bats; the restless dead and skeletal acolytes who answer each other's call; a bone warden, a fallen choirmaster and a roof gargoyle; the Sexton in the Ossuary; and the Hollow Bishop at the Diamond Altar, whose risen come in waves while the light dies and his rot spreads across the floor.

43100.name: rat grave
43100.long_desc: A grave rat noses among the leaning headstones.
43100.description: Big as a cat and bald in patches, with a pink tail and a taste for what lies beneath the churchyard.

43101.name: restless dead corpse
43101.long_desc: A restless dead shambles through the dark in a rotted burial shroud.
43101.description: Grey flesh, a slack jaw, and grave-dirt under the nails. Whatever the bishop prays to, it does not let the dead of Garathorm sleep.

helpers.shout: A dry rattle echoes through the stone, and the dead stir!

43102.name: beetle crypt
43102.long_desc: A crypt beetle the size of a shield clicks across the stone.
43102.description: A glossy black carapace, mandibles like shears, and a smell of old tombs.

43103.name: bats belfry swarm
43103.long_desc: A swarm of belfry bats wheels and chitters overhead.
43103.description: Hundreds of small brown bats that roost among the bells and boil out at any noise.

43104.name: skeletal acolyte skeleton
43104.long_desc: A skeletal acolyte drifts between the pews, still swinging a censer of cold ash.
43104.description: Bones in the rags of a novice's robe, a rusted censer on a chain. It keeps the services its master has twisted, and calls the dead when it is disturbed.

helpers.shout: A dry rattle echoes through the stone, and the dead stir!

43110.name: bone warden
43110.long_desc: The bone warden stands among the skulls, a great maul of fused bone in its hands.
43110.description: A towering thing built from the bones of many, its ribcage a cage of femurs and its head a horned ox-skull. It guards the corridors of the ossuary.

helpers.shout: A dry rattle echoes through the stone, and the dead stir!

43111.name: choirmaster fallen
43111.long_desc: The fallen choirmaster sways at the great organ, singing a hymn backwards.
43111.description: Once the finest voice in Garathorm; now a withered shade in a mouldering surplice whose song makes the ears bleed.

43112.name: gargoyle roof
43112.long_desc: A gargoyle crouches on the roof edge, too still to be stone.
43112.description: Lichen-spotted granite wings, a lion's face worn by rain, and claws that score the leads when it moves.

43120.name: sexton sunless
43120.short_desc: the Sexton of the Sunless Lands
43120.long_desc: The Sexton of the Sunless Lands leans on his spade among the bones of the Ossuary.
43120.description: The cathedral's gravedigger, who dug for the bishop long after the last honest burial. His spade is black with grave-earth and his eyes are two cold coals.

helpers.shout: A dry rattle echoes through the stone, and the dead stir!

43130.name: hollow bishop
43130.long_desc: The Hollow Bishop kneels before the Diamond Altar, and rises as you enter.
43130.description: A tall figure in rotting vestments of white and gold, a mitre on a head that is only a shell: the face is a mask over darkness. He turned his prayers to something under the cathedral, and it answered.

phases.message: The Hollow Bishop spreads his arms, and the Diamond Altar blazes with black light!

abilities.name: Black Sermon
abilities.telegraph: The Hollow Bishop begins a dreadful sermon, and the air grows heavy!

abilities.name: Crozier Strike
abilities.telegraph: The Hollow Bishop raises his crozier high!

abilities.name: Last Rites
abilities.telegraph: The Hollow Bishop begins to read your last rites!

an acolyte keeps its round of the great hall

mechanics.shout: The Hollow Bishop lifts his crozier, and the dead of the catacombs climb up through the floor!

mechanics.label: Consecrated Rot

mechanics.why: the light dies as he weakens
